description: EMS-Simulator is published by EMSTrack. EMS-Simulator provides an extensible software framework for ambulance dispatch simulation and analysis. Its stated coverage is General ambulance-dispatch models; local configuration required. Further dates and resolution are unknown unless specified by the provider. Source code and setup information are linked through the public repository; nothing was installed or executed. The inspected public resource is free to access. The licence is MIT. Published functions do not establish performance in an untested local service. For simulation, it can inform emergency-response planning and comparisons of demand against available resources; this is a reviewer assessment of potential use. Related record model-jemss provides a comparison in the same service area; technical compatibility was not tested.
